home.aboutText: BTC is an independent software initiative led by software engineers specializing in AI — not a traditional research lab. We focus on the computational side of the life sciences: building tools, sharing knowledge, and simplifying concepts.

about.title: About
about.intro: The BTC Bioinformatics Platform is an independent software initiative working at the intersection of computational biology and artificial intelligence.
about.visionText: To become a trusted Arabic-language digital reference for bioinformatics tools and knowledge, and to make biological analysis tools freely and easily available to everyone.
about.missionText: To build high-quality open tools, publish verified Arabic educational content, and apply AI to simplify biological data analysis for researchers, students, and enthusiasts.
about.transparencyText: We are not a wet lab and we do not claim to run laboratory experiments. We are a software team focused on the computational side: software, algorithms, and digital education. This transparency is the foundation of our credibility.

tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Bioinformatics tools that run directly in your browser — free and open source.

list.name: DNA sequence analyzer
list.description: Compute GC content, reverse complement, transcription to RNA, and translation to protein.

list.name: Primer melting temperature (Tm) calculator
list.description: Compute primer length, GC content, melting temperature (Tm), and reverse complement.

dna.title: DNA sequence analyzer
dna.description: Enter a DNA sequence to get base counts, GC content, reverse complement, transcription to mRNA, and translation to a protein sequence.

errors.title: Error
errors.invalid: The sequence contains invalid characters. Accepted: A, C, G, T (plus IUPAC ambiguity codes such as R, Y, S, N).
errors.tooShort: The sequence is too short — enter at least 3 bases.

primer.title: Primer melting temperature (Tm) calculator
primer.description: Enter a primer sequence to get its length, GC content, melting temperature (Tm) using two formulas, and reverse complement.

errors.title: Error
errors.invalid: The sequence contains invalid DNA characters.
errors.tooShort: The primer is too short — enter at least 8 bases.

results.title: Results
results.gcClampNo: Does not end with G or C
results.note: Note: these values are estimates for educational purposes. For laboratory-grade accuracy, use specialized software such as Primer3 or OligoCalc.
